questions.implements: Does the diff implement what the repository records for the Jira issue, and add or change a test that checks it? Judge the code in the diff, not the answer.

judge.reason: The diff implements the recorded rule. `volumeDiscount` takes 5% off each line with 10 or more units and rounds each line down with `Math.floor`. `price` applies the discount code to `subtotal - volume`, so the volume discount comes before any code. It then caps volume plus code at 50% of the subtotal, so the volume discount counts toward the cap. `checkout.ts` passes the volume discount into `price`. The new tests check all of this. The pricing test confirms per-line rounding down (each 50.5-cent line discount becomes 50, for 100 total), that 9 units get no discount, that the 10% code applies after the volume discount (282 on 2,820, for 382 total), and that a 100% code is capped at 1,460. The checkout test confirms that 10 units get the 500-cent discount end to end.

finalMessage:
Implemented SHOP-57. Cart lines with 10 or more units now receive 5% off, rounded down per line. Checkout applies that discount before any code and keeps the combined discount within the 50% cap. I added code and test links to `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT` in [trace.yaml](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.intent.ts-shop.T5.2/repo/trace.yaml).

The change keeps the linked items `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`, `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER`, `R-CHECKOUT-SESSION`, and `R-TAX-RATE` true. No risk or threat control item was touched.

The linked pricing and checkout tests pass, including the new volume discount tests. The full suite passes: **38 tests**.
